_about: Rules for the industry x city local service pages under /google-maps-marketing/ (local pages 2.0). Read by scripts/local_pages/check_local_pages.py (CI) and by the BYM Team connector. The page skeleton, data modules and gates come from the vendored ai-skills shared/local-pages config (scripts/local_pages/vendor/local-pages/config.json); put a BYM-only override under local_gate. Any industry and any city can be built (decided 2026-10-05). Only Mike edits this file; page pull requests may not touch it.
_industries_note: Not an approval list. Names and brief titles for industries already built; a new industry's page supplies industry_name itself. Set restrict_industries to true only to limit pages to this list again.

publishing._cadence_note: The pause switch above is the brake. Publishing pace is advisory and set in brain.web_sites.cadence (page-pipeline cadence.py and the connector read it); no volume limits as of 2026-10-05.

_queue_note: Decision pending Mike (2026-11-10). page-pipeline and the connector build a page only from an approved row in brain.web_page_queue. auto_approve true keeps the 2026-10-05 'no approval' rule: the connector adds or approves the row itself when the page ships. auto_approve false: Mike approves rows in batches.
_thresholds_note: words_min/words_max are not a target: the data sets the length, and outside the band is a warning only. shingle_size, any_page and same_industry_or_city feed the local-pages overlap gate (G4).
